cacheHitRateTooltip: Cached input tokens / total input tokens in the latest displayed snapshot; not a request-level hit count. -- means no input tokens are available.
contextUnavailable: This task did not report a context-window size.
estimatedCostTooltip: API-price equivalent only. Any model can be monitored; unknown prices show --.
behaviorHint: Task interaction, quiet indicator, and context safeguards.
idleIndicatorHint: Keep one overall light or a numbered row/column after quiet time.
contextAlertsHint: Default: 75%, 90%, 98%. Enter 1–3 values (1–99); save low to high.
contextMetricVisible: Show context in detached bubbles (list always shows it; required for alerts)
multiTaskExplanation: Summary stays compact. List uses stable numbers. Split creates independent bubbles. Weekly allowance is account-wide.
listDetailHint: Model and context always show; Detailed wraps diagnostics.
listDetailCompact: Compact: status, model, context, cache hit
listDetailDetailed: Detailed: + input mix, output, task total, window, cost, time
taskBubbleResizeHint: Drag the lower-right corner of any independent bubble to resize it. Its fields are separate from the list.
dismissTask: Remove from HUD; it returns when this conversation runs again
closeTaskBubble: Close this bubble only; main monitoring continues
sessionSourcesHint: Task rows use compact source icons only; hover an icon for its full name.
sessionSourcesPrivacy: Read-only metadata and token counts; no credentials or configuration are read or changed.
agentNotificationHint: OPT-IN PLAIN TEXT. SEPARATE FROM AUTOMATIC STATUS ALERTS.
agentNotificationTooltip: OPT-IN MCP NOTICE. MATCHING TASK ONLY.
quotaGuardHint: OPT-IN CHECKPOINT HANDOFF. CODEX ALLOWANCE ONLY.
quotaGuardTemplatesHint: DEFAULTS UPDATE AN EXISTING PROJECT HANDOFF FIRST.
quotaGuardPrepareDefault: Allowance is low. Before broad work, update the project's existing handoff or write a concise recoverable handoff with state, changed files, verification, unfinished work, and the next exact command.
quotaGuardHandoffDefault: Allowance is critical. Do not start broad new work. Update the project's existing handoff or write one with state, changed files, verification, unfinished work, blockers, and the next exact command. Save it, then stop expanding scope.
quotaGuardTooltip: ENTER 1–99. DEFAULT: WARN 15 / 10; CRITICAL 5 / 3. CRITICAL STAYS AT OR BELOW WARNING. CODEX READS THIS AT CHECKPOINTS.
attentionHint: Put motion only on the task that actually needs you back.
attentionTooltip: task_complete / Stop mark the end of one turn. Silent endings are ignored and an 8-second continuation guard reduces false positives.
attentionRoutingTooltip: Only the matching visible surface reacts: summary, list row, or independent bubble.
dotAttentionHint: Flash pattern, brightness and subtle scale breathing are independent.
attentionCompletedTooltip: Remind after a visible turn ends and does not immediately resume within 8 seconds.
attentionWaitingTooltip: Remind when Claude Code asks for permission or waits for input.
attentionAbortedOrErrorTooltip: Remind on an explicit abort or temporary session-read error.
attentionSettledTooltip: Quiet-time inference can mistake a thinking gap for an ending, so it is disabled by default.
presetsHint: Choose a polished starting point, then tune it to your workflow.
themeWorkshopHint: Drop a theme file here to validate and install it.
themeWorkshopTooltip: Supports declarative themes and safe ZIP packs with local PNG/JPG assets. No scripts or network resources.
terminalExitHint: TARGET ROW OR BUBBLE ONLY. BOUNDED DURATION.
metricsHint: Cached input is part of input and is not counted twice. Aggregate mode combines the latest snapshot from each active task.
pricingSourceHint: ANY MODEL IS MONITORED. UNKNOWN PRICE = --. DATED SNAPSHOTS USE THE MATCHING LOCAL CATALOG MODEL.
pricingPathTooltip: LOCAL CODEX-USAGE-TRACKER PRICING SCHEMA. NO NETWORK.
transparencyHint: Fade the shell while keeping important numbers and status readable.
mousePassthroughHint: When enabled, the HUD no longer receives mouse input. Use the desktop/Start settings shortcut, the tray icon, or ask Codex / Claude to disable click-through.
mousePassthroughConfirm: You will not be able to drag, double-click or right-click the HUD while click-through is enabled. The settings window will stay open as an immediate recovery path; later, use the tray icon, the settings shortcut or ask Codex / Claude to disable it.
animateUpdatesTooltip: Uses a subtle fade only when tasks, display mode, or status phase really changes. Token counter refreshes never flash the whole window.
statusPalettesHint: A scheme changes seven status colors; every color remains editable.
statusPaletteCodexMicroSource: Codex Micro reference values were sampled from OpenAI's public Codex Micro page. They are local visual references only; OpenAI does not endorse this project, and device, display, color-management, accessibility, and theme differences can prevent a match with the page or hardware lighting.
rhythmTooltip: Token rhythm over the last {0} minutes and today's total (as observed by the HUD)
resizeMainBubble: Drag to loosen spacing · double-click for tight
